tables.name: Physical Forms
tables.count_note: Source lists 35 entries for this table (one short of the 36 expected for a 6x6 grid). Preserved as-is rather than inventing a 36th entry; flagged here for transparency.

tables.name: Spells (formula)
tables.usage_note: Roll 2d and read as one d12 to find the spell formula, then roll on the two indicated tables to build the spell name. The GM narrates the effect based on the resulting name.

tables.name: Mutations
tables.usage_note: Use these results for magical curses, or spells that have gone wrong somehow.

tables.name: Insanities
tables.usage_note: Results in quotation marks are things that are believed to be true by the insane character.

tables.name: Monster Base (animal category selector)
tables.usage_note: Source calls this table "Monster Base": roll once, or roll twice and combine the results. Rolls which animal sub-table (aerial/terrestrial/aquatic) to roll on.

tables.name: Monster Personalities
tables.usage_note: Roll on this table or on the Personalities table from the Characters section.

tables.name: Wilderness NPCs
tables.count_note: Source lists 36 entries with 'Tinker' appearing twice (35 unique roles); preserved verbatim rather than silently deduplicating.

tables.name: NPC Names (combinator)
tables.usage_note: Combines a first-name table with a surname table.

tables.name: NPC Professions (combinator)
tables.usage_note: Rolls which profession sub-table (civilized/underworld/wilderness) to roll on.

tables.name: Book Subjects
tables.usage_note: When a PC finds a useful book, roll 1d. The result is the number of questions the book can answer.

tables.name: Valuable Materials
tables.count_note: Source lists the last entry as the combined phrase 'Topaz turquoise'; split here into two separate entries (Topaz, Turquoise) to reach the expected 36, matching the alphabetized pattern of the rest of the table. Flagged as an editorial split, not an invented item.

tables.name: Items (category selector)
tables.usage_note: Rolls which item sub-table to roll on. 'Book' is a direct result, not a sub-table.

tables.name: Inn Quirks
tables.count_note: Source lists 37 entries (one over the 36 expected for a 6x6 grid); preserved verbatim.
